## Summary

Describe the observable behavior changed and the boundary it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has deterministic automated coverage.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots, traces, and logs are synthetic and privacy-scanned.
- [ ] No remote runtime asset, analytics, or hidden network dependency was added.
- [ ] Protocol, security, accessibility, compatibility, and migration impacts are documented.

## Privacy and noninterference

- [ ] The change does not persist prompts, messages, source, patches, commands,
      arguments, output, paths, URLs, credentials, environment values,
      transcripts, remotes, or user names.
- [ ] Adapter behavior remains observational and fail open.
